subject: Seat award request: strategic Solutions Engineer + AE extension
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Seat award request: strategic Solutions Engineer + AE extension

Team —

As discussed in last week's GTM planning sync, product is shipping two integrations (HealthConnect & ClaimsBridge) that will materially expand our pipeline in healthcare. I ran the coverage model and recommend awarding one immediate seat for a Senior Solutions Engineer (Seattle hire) and extending an AE sprint capacity (+1 AE) for the quarter to accelerate mid-market closes tied to the integrations.

Summary ask:
- +1 Senior Solutions Engineer (L6) — headcount and comp-band approval to recruit now. Proposed comp band: $165k–$210k OTE (see attached comp-band-case-SE.pdf).
- +1 Account Executive (quarter-limited sprint) — hire/contract through Q1 to support integration-driven opportunities; conservative revenue projection attached (q4-ramp-and-revenue-proj.xlsx).

Why now:
- Three qualified PoCs (HealthCo, Mediva, Acme Health) will require SE pre-sales support in Oct/Nov to convert. We will lose momentum without a dedicated senior SE.
- The AE sprint is revenue-accretive in our model (expected $450k–750k incremental ACV tied to integration deals if we hit conversion assumptions).

Budget and funding idea:
- I recommend funding the senior SE from the product/partner co-invest (we have a partial partner credit) and shift an under-deployed SDR headcount to the AE sprint for Q4. I attached a short reallocation note that shows the math.

Next steps I need from you this week:
1) Marissa — approval to open req + confirm comp-band signoff or escalation path.
2) Jonas — confirm if we can reallocate 1 SDR budget to AE sprint or if we need to pull from the spare GTM buffer.
3) Priyom — final OK on the funding mix and any finance constraints to be aware of for Q4.

Attachments: comp-band-case-SE.pdf, q4-ramp-and-revenue-proj.xlsx, headcount-reallocation-note.docx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15 to walk through the deck.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Solutions Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T11:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seat award request: strategic Solutions Engineer + AE extension

Thanks Mateo — good write-up. A couple quick clarifying questions before I lock approval: 

1) Comp band: your ask lists $165k–$210k OTE for the SE. Is that base+bonus or OTE assumptions (split)? HR will need the proposed base range and target variable to load the req correctly.
2) Ramp assumptions: can you call out the worst-case conversion (50% of your midpoint) and how long we hold the AE sprint if we see slow movement?

If answers look reasonable I'll approve opening the req for the SE and provisionally clear the AE sprint for Q4 pending Jonas/finance.

On the reallocation note — I want to make sure we aren't starving next-quarter top-of-funnel. If we take an SDR offline, what's the compensating plan?

On calendar: I can do 15m today at 3pm PT.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-10T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seat award request: strategic Solutions Engineer + AE extension

Appreciate the model, Mateo. Quick take:
- SE seat: approve. The integration pipeline dependence is clear and I prefer hiring a senior to avoid ramp regressions. Base/variable split requested by Marissa should be set to 70/30 for comp planning.
- AE sprint: I am cautious about creating permanent headcount here. I can approve a Q4 sprint if we fold it into a 90-day contract-to-hire stance with clear OKRs. If the sprint is truly variable, let's treat it as a temporary contractor AE to preserve full-time headcount discipline.

On the SDR reallocation: we can reassign SDR coverage for 10 weeks and supplement with 4 hours/week of paid SDR agency support (budget ~ $12k) to keep the funnel full. That preserves top-of-funnel while enabling the AE sprint. See the attached headcount-reallocation-note.docx for numbers.

Jonas
Director, Field GTM Strategy | Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Seat award and AE sprint funding

Folks —

I ran the funding split with finance this morning and we have room to approve both asks with the following constraints: 
- Senior SE (L6): approved to open and offer within comp band of base $125k–$150k with target variable ~25–30% (OTE aligns to Mateo's range). Please make the job posting reflect base and target variable. HR/payroll needs the exact job-family code; Mateo/Marissa please confirm with People Ops.
- AE sprint: approved as a 90-day contractor-to-hire with a defined KPI slate. Budget will be taken from GTM buffer and Jonas's SDR temporary reallocation + $12k agency support.

Conditions: 
1) Candidate offers for the SE must be run by Marissa before extending to ensure band compliance.
2) If the AE does not meet the agreed KPIs by day 75, we pause conversion and re-assess; revenue recognition assumptions will be adjusted in the QBR.

I'll loop in Finance Ops to provision the budget transfer and HR to open the reqs. Mateo — please coordinate the job spec and attach the final band language (HR needs that text).

— Priyom

VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
